title: AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling
paper_type_zh: 智能体失败轨迹后见目标重标与训练数据构造方法
best_for_zh: 研究 agent trajectory 数据构造、LLM judge、SFT/DPO 复用与环境可重放性审计的读者
one_line: AgentHER relabels recoverable failed WebArena and ToolBench episodes with LLM-synthesized hindsight goals and packages them as severity-weighted SFT, DPO, or ShareGPT records, while the public code and experiment release remain materially incomplete.
AgentHER 用 LLM 生成的后见目标重标可恢复的 WebArena 与 ToolBench 失败 episode，并封装为 severity-weighted SFT、DPO 或 ShareGPT 记录，但公开代码与实验发布仍存在关键缺口。
why: It treats failed agent interaction logs as reusable post-training data instead of waste and makes the relabeling judge, confidence gate, and failure-severity policy part of the data contract; those same learned components can also introduce false positives, false negatives, and unreproducible selection bias.
inclusion_reason: AgentHER is a direct reasoning-data construction recipe: it converts recoverable failed agent episodes into positive full-episode supervision and preference records under an explicit learned-judge and severity-filter contract.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The canonical source is arXiv:2603.21357 v4, revised 2026-05-10; the verified OpenReview record does not establish an accepted venue. AgentHER asks whether a failed agent run must be discarded when its recorded actions and observations may already constitute a valid demonstration for a different, achievable goal. The decision boundary is data construction, not a new WebArena or ToolBench benchmark: those environments supply source episodes and terminal outcomes, while AgentHER transforms selected failures into post-training records.

The input object is a failed run (g_i, tau_i, f_i). The trajectory tau_i is an ordered sequence of thought, action, and observation triples, and the released schema adds trajectory_id, original_prompt, final_answer, failure_reason, and metadata. The construction later adds failure type, recoverability, severity, observation-grounded achievements, a hindsight prompt, two judge confidences, rationale, and output-format fields. One accepted episode can become an SFT conversation, a DPO chosen/rejected record, or a ShareGPT dialogue; AgentHER does not regenerate the underlying environment interaction.

The concrete gap is that success-only demonstration pipelines waste recoverable failures, but a useful alternative label must not reward an unsupported goal. The paper therefore makes failure selection, outcome extraction, hindsight-goal synthesis, judge agreement, and severity weighting part of the data contract. Original task success remains environment-specific, whereas the relabeled pair is accepted by learned judges over the recorded observations rather than by live environment replay.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the trainable object is a full web-navigation or API/tool-use episode. It is also a construction recipe, not evidence of RLVR: the reported uses are SFT, DPO/preference learning, and agent fine-tuning. The public package reads serialized JSON/JSONL trajectories but does not release the experimental corpus, environment adapters, executable terminal predicates, or replay manifests.

Primary links and the code artifact are verified, but the accepted metadata remains L3_summary_ready and partial. The section depth supports bilingual review without upgrading curation state: arXiv v4 and GitHub commit 98072c34db5ee65a22e43f8621b5ec76a9c995e1 describe materially different points in the project, and release completeness, data rights, exact experiment reproduction, and replay remain unresolved.

规范主来源是修订于 2026-05-10 的 arXiv:2603.21357 v4；已验证的 OpenReview 记录不能证明论文已被某个会议接收。AgentHER 追问：当一次失败运行中记录的 action 与 observation 已经能构成另一个可达目标的有效示范时，是否仍应把整条运行丢弃。其决策边界是数据构造，而不是提出新的 WebArena 或 ToolBench benchmark：这两个 environment 提供源 episode 与终止 outcome，AgentHER 则把经筛选的失败 episode 转换为 post-training 记录。

输入对象是失败运行 (g_i, tau_i, f_i)。其中 trajectory tau_i 是有序的 thought、action、observation 三元组序列；公开 schema 还包含 trajectory_id、original_prompt、final_answer、failure_reason 与 metadata。构造过程随后加入 failure type、recoverability、severity、由 observation 支持的 achievement、hindsight prompt、两个 judge confidence、rationale 与输出格式字段。一条 accepted episode 可变成 SFT conversation、DPO chosen/rejected 记录或 ShareGPT 对话；AgentHER 不会重新生成底层 environment interaction。

具体缺口是：只保留成功示范的 pipeline 会浪费可恢复失败，但替代标签又不能奖励一项目测不到的目标。因此论文把 failure selection、outcome extraction、hindsight-goal synthesis、judge agreement 与 severity weighting 都纳入数据契约。原任务是否成功仍由具体 environment 决定，重标 pair 的接受则由 learned judge 根据已记录 observation 判断，而不是通过 live environment replay。

该工作属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为可训练对象是完整的 web-navigation 或 API/tool-use episode。它同时是一套 construction recipe，但不是 RLVR 证据：论文报告的用途只有 SFT、DPO/preference learning 与 agent fine-tuning。公开 package 读取序列化 JSON/JSONL 轨迹，却没有发布实验语料、environment adapter、可执行 terminal predicate 或 replay manifest。

官方主链接与代码 artifact 已验证，但 accepted metadata 仍保持 L3_summary_ready 和 partial。正文深度足以进入双语 review，却不能据此升级 curation state：arXiv v4 与 GitHub commit 98072c34db5ee65a22e43f8621b5ec76a9c995e1 对应项目中实质不同的时间点，发布完整性、数据权利、精确实验复现与 replay 均未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AgentHER's contribution is to convert a recoverable failed episode into positive supervision for what the same episode actually achieved, while retaining explicit selection and validation signals. Instead of rewriting the trajectory, it infers an observation-supported hindsight goal and pairs that goal with the original behavior.

The core data object has three layers. The source layer stores the original goal and a full thought-action-observation episode with its failure reason. The relabeling layer stores a six-way failure type—incomplete, constraint violation, wrong result, tool error, hallucination, or off topic—recoverability, a severity weight, actual achievements, key observations, the hindsight prompt, rationale, and judge confidences. The consumption layer packages the accepted object as SFT, DPO, or ShareGPT. For DPO, the chosen conversation uses the hindsight prompt plus the trajectory, while the rejected conversation uses the original prompt plus that same trajectory; the prompts therefore differ.

The feedback contract is mixed. WebArena or ToolBench supplies the original failure/success outcome. For relabeling, the paper uses gpt-4o-mini to extract outcomes and propose a hindsight prompt, then Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at T=0 as an independently trained second judge. Each judge is intended to reach theta=0.5, with up to K=3 attempts. Algorithm 1 also allows a best single-judge fallback at 0.8*theta=0.4, so the operational boundary is weaker than an unqualified “both judges agree” summary. Severity then scales the SFT loss or DPO margin; it is a sample weight, not an environment reward or RLVR signal.

The direction is failure-to-demonstration relabeling for agent trajectories. Compared with success-only SFT, AgentHER tries to recover useful behavior from failures. Compared with goal-conditioned hindsight experience replay, the relabeled goal is natural language and validated by LLM judges. Compared with ordinary synthetic preference construction, the same fixed episode appears under two different goals, so downstream DPO code must preserve prompt context rather than treating the pair as two answers to one prompt.

The category rationale follows the object and feedback surface: full episodes, pairwise preferences, and scalar weights are attached to offline environment traces. State/action fields are present, but there is no step-local correctness label, process reward, replayed success check, or policy-gradient objective. The nearest comparisons should therefore be methods that relabel failed agent trajectories or analyze failure retention, not generic agent benchmarks or RLVR datasets.

AgentHER 的贡献是把一条可恢复的失败 episode 转换为针对“该 episode 实际完成了什么”的正向监督，并保留显式 selection 与 validation 信号。它不重写 trajectory，而是推断一个由 observation 支持的 hindsight goal，再把该目标与原始行为配对。

核心数据对象分为三层。source layer 保存原始 goal、完整 thought-action-observation episode 与 failure reason。relabeling layer 保存六类 failure type——incomplete、constraint violation、wrong result、tool error、hallucination、off topic——以及 recoverability、severity weight、actual achievements、key observations、hindsight prompt、rationale 与 judge confidence。consumption layer 把 accepted object 封装成 SFT、DPO 或 ShareGPT。对于 DPO，chosen conversation 使用 hindsight prompt 加 trajectory，rejected conversation 使用 original prompt 加同一条 trajectory；因此两侧 prompt 并不相同。

反馈契约是 mixed。WebArena 或 ToolBench 提供原任务的 failure/success outcome。对重标过程，论文用 gpt-4o-mini 提取 outcome 并生成 hindsight prompt，再用 T=0 的 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 作为独立训练的 second judge。设计上每个 judge 都应达到 theta=0.5，最多尝试 K=3 次；但 Algorithm 1 还允许用 0.8*theta=0.4 的最佳 single-judge 结果 fallback，因此实际边界比不加限定的“两个 judge 一致”更弱。随后 severity 缩放 SFT loss 或 DPO margin；它是 sample weight，不是 environment reward，也不是 RLVR 信号。

该方向可概括为 agent trajectory 的 failure-to-demonstration relabeling。相对只使用成功轨迹的 SFT，AgentHER 试图从失败中恢复有用行为；相对 goal-conditioned hindsight experience replay，它用自然语言表达重标目标，并由 LLM judge 验证；相对普通 synthetic preference construction，同一条固定 episode 会出现在两个不同 goal 之下，因此下游 DPO 代码必须保留 prompt context，不能把 pair 当成同一 prompt 的两个 answer。

分类依据来自数据对象与反馈面：full episode、pairwise preference 与 scalar weight 都附着在 offline environment trace 上。虽然存在 state/action 字段，却没有 step-local correctness label、process reward、replayed success check 或 policy-gradient objective。最接近的对比应是重标失败 agent trajectory 或审计失败保留的方法，而不是泛化的 agent benchmark 或 RLVR 数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs come from WebArena WA-TRAIN and the official ToolBench training splits. The paper reports a 612-task WA-TRAIN/200-task WA-HELDOUT split stratified by category with seed 0, then collects 3,000 failed plus 500 successful WebArena trajectories and 5,000 failed plus 2,000 successful ToolBench trajectories with gpt-3.5-turbo-0125. These counts describe the experiments; neither the complete source corpus nor the promised WebArena split JSON is present in the inspected repository snapshot.

The offline construction has four stages. First, a failure detector assigns one of six failure types, recoverability, and severity; irrecoverable runs and major flaws with paper severity weight below delta=0.3 are rejected. Second, gpt-4o-mini extracts actual achievements and key observations, with prompts instructing it to stay grounded in observations. Third, gpt-4o-mini proposes a hindsight prompt matched in style and complexity to the original; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct independently judges whether the whole recorded episode satisfies it. The relabeler uses T=0.3 for the first attempt and T=0.7 for retries, the verifier uses T=0, and at most three attempts are made. Both confidences should reach theta=0.5, subject to Algorithm 1's 0.4 best-candidate fallback. Fourth, deterministic converters emit SFT, DPO, or ShareGPT records.

The output preserves full-episode supervision but its serialization differs by format. SFT pairs the hindsight prompt with an assistant reconstruction and scales loss by severity. DPO uses the hindsight-goal conversation as chosen and the original-goal conversation as rejected, with the same episode and a severity-scaled margin. ShareGPT interleaves the hindsight prompt, assistant thought/action turns, observation turns, and a final answer when present. In the public code, SFT and DPO assistant strings truncate every observation to 300 characters; ShareGPT retains full observation text. The SFT/DPO artifacts therefore are not full replay logs even when the source input is longer.

Reported open-weight training uses LoRA rank 16 and alpha 32, SFT for 3 epochs, DPO for 1 epoch with beta 0.1, maximum sequence length 4,096, ms-swift, and 8 A100-80G GPUs. GPT-4o uses the OpenAI fine-tuning API, and an 8-shot ICL condition is also evaluated. Exact model and tokenizer revisions, OpenAI API snapshot, environment step/token budgets, and complete training/evaluation commands are unknown.

The verifier/environment boundary is crucial. Benchmark environments establish original outcomes, but the hindsight goal is not executed again. Learned judges assess support in the serialized observation record, so the release lacks an executable terminal predicate for the new goal. Reproduction also requires separate relabeler and verifier clients, pinned prompts/models, raw and rejected records, the task split, environment adapters, resets, tool/API versions, and replay manifests. The inspected package provides none of the experimental data, fine-tuning scripts, evaluation scripts, or annotation assets.

输入来自 WebArena WA-TRAIN 与 ToolBench 官方 training split。论文报告把 WebArena 按类别、seed 0 划为 612 个 WA-TRAIN task 与 200 个 WA-HELDOUT task，并用 gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 收集 3,000 条失败加 500 条成功 WebArena trajectory，以及 5,000 条失败加 2,000 条成功 ToolBench trajectory。这些数字描述的是实验；完整 source corpus 与论文所称发布的 WebArena split JSON 都未出现在已检查 repository snapshot 中。

offline 构造包含四个阶段。第一，failure detector 预测六类 failure type、recoverability 与 severity；irrecoverable 运行以及论文 severity weight 低于 delta=0.3 的重大缺陷被拒绝。第二，gpt-4o-mini 提取 actual achievements 与 key observations，prompt 要求结论只能基于 observation。第三，gpt-4o-mini 生成与原 prompt 风格、复杂度相匹配的 hindsight prompt；Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 独立判断完整记录 episode 是否满足它。relabeler 首次尝试用 T=0.3、重试用 T=0.7，verifier 用 T=0，最多尝试三次。两个 confidence 原则上都应达到 theta=0.5，但 Algorithm 1 允许采用 0.4 的最佳候选 fallback。第四，确定性的 converter 输出 SFT、DPO 或 ShareGPT 记录。

输出保留 full-episode supervision，但不同格式的序列化并不相同。SFT 把 hindsight prompt 与 assistant reconstruction 配对，并由 severity 缩放 loss。DPO 把 hindsight-goal conversation 作为 chosen，把 original-goal conversation 作为 rejected；二者使用同一 episode，并由 severity 缩放 margin。ShareGPT 交错保存 hindsight prompt、assistant thought/action turn、observation turn，并在存在时保留 final answer。公开代码中，SFT 与 DPO 的 assistant 字符串把每条 observation 截断为 300 个字符，而 ShareGPT 保留完整 observation text。因此即使 source input 更长，SFT/DPO artifact 也不是完整 replay log。

论文报告 open-weight training 使用 LoRA rank 16、alpha 32，SFT 训练 3 epoch，DPO 训练 1 epoch且 beta 0.1，最大 sequence length 4,096，框架为 ms-swift，硬件为 8 张 A100-80G。GPT-4o 使用 OpenAI fine-tuning API，另有 8-shot ICL 条件。精确 model/tokenizer revision、OpenAI API snapshot、environment step/token budget 与完整 training/evaluation command 均为 unknown。

verifier/environment 边界至关重要。benchmark environment 确认的是原任务 outcome，hindsight goal 并未被再次执行；learned judge 只检查序列化 observation record 是否支持目标，因此发布中没有面向新目标的可执行 terminal predicate。要复现实验，还需要独立 relabeler/verifier client、固定 prompt/model、raw 与 rejected record、task split、environment adapter、reset、tool/API version 和 replay manifest。已检查 package 不包含实验数据、fine-tuning script、evaluation script 或 annotation asset。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All quantitative results below are author-reported from arXiv v4 and were not independently reproduced. In the reported construction, single-judge acceptance is 78.0% on 3,000 WebArena failures and 82.5% on 5,000 ToolBench failures; cross-model MJ-X acceptance is 71.5% and 75.5%, respectively. These yields show how selective the pipeline is under the paper's judges, not how complete or reusable the unreleased corpus is.

Table 1 reports MJ-X success of 29.9, 37.7, 26.5, and 24.8 on WebArena for GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72B, Qwen2.5-7B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, with gains of 7.6–8.7 points over SFT-Success. On ToolBench the corresponding scores are 75.4, 83.5, 72.6, and 69.0, with gains of 7.6–11.4 points. Under the paper's infrastructure, MJ-X is 3.0–6.2 points above AWM. These comparisons support the claim that the relabeled records can be useful in the reported training setup; they do not by themselves validate label correctness, release completeness, or data rights.

The judge ablation is more directly relevant to the data contract. On WebArena, cross-model MJ-X obtains 26.5% success with 2.9% label noise; same-model MJ-S obtains 26.0% with 4.4% noise; a single judge obtains 25.7% with 5.9% noise. Removing the confidence filter drops success to 22.3% and raises label noise to 15.0%. This supports treating judge identity and filtering as construction variables rather than incidental evaluation settings.

Human evaluation samples 200 pairs per benchmark, uses three NLP-PhD annotators and majority vote, and reports MJ-X precision of 97.1% on WebArena and 96.0% on ToolBench, with Fleiss kappa 0.82 and 0.79. The same audit finds that 38.7% of WebArena and 35.8% of ToolBench pairs rejected by the filter are valid according to humans. Precision is therefore accompanied by substantial false-negative selection bias; the study does not establish recall for the full source distribution or live-environment validity of hindsight goals.

Further evidence is conditional. Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 72B all improve under the reported setup, and iterative Qwen2.5-7B redeployment on WA-HELDOUT rises from 17.8 to 26.5, 27.9, and 28.2 over rounds 0–3 while acceptance declines from 71.5% to 68.4% and 66.0%. A 363-trajectory looping subset has only 24.2% recoverability, 21.5% acceptance, and a 3.4-point gain versus 9.5 points for non-looping failures. These negative and scaling results help locate where the recipe works; none turns benchmark performance into proof of data quality.

以下定量结果全部来自 arXiv v4 的作者报告，未被独立复现。在论文所述构造中，对 3,000 条 WebArena 失败轨迹，single-judge acceptance 为 78.0%；对 5,000 条 ToolBench 失败轨迹则为 82.5%。cross-model MJ-X acceptance 分别为 71.5% 与 75.5%。这些 yield 只说明论文 judge 下的选择强度，不能证明未发布语料的完整性或可复用性。

Table 1 报告 MJ-X 在 WebArena 上对 GPT-4o、Qwen2.5-72B、Qwen2.5-7B 与 LLaMA-3.1-8B 的 success 分别为 29.9、37.7、26.5、24.8，相对 SFT-Success 提升 7.6–8.7 个点；ToolBench 对应分数为 75.4、83.5、72.6、69.0，提升 7.6–11.4 个点。在论文基础设施下，MJ-X 比 AWM 高 3.0–6.2 个点。这些对比支持重标记录可用于论文所述训练设置，却不能单独验证 label correctness、release completeness 或 data rights。

与数据契约更直接相关的是 judge ablation。在 WebArena 上，cross-model MJ-X 得到 26.5% success、2.9% label noise；same-model MJ-S 为 26.0% 与 4.4%；single judge 为 25.7% 与 5.9%。移除 confidence filter 后，success 降至 22.3%，label noise 升至 15.0%。这支持把 judge identity 与 filtering 视为构造变量，而不是附带的评测设置。

人工评测对每个 benchmark 抽样 200 个 pair，由三名 NLP PhD annotator 标注并多数票聚合；MJ-X precision 在 WebArena 为 97.1%、ToolBench 为 96.0%，Fleiss kappa 分别为 0.82 与 0.79。同一审计发现，在被 filter 拒绝的 pair 中，人类认为有效的比例在 WebArena 为 38.7%、ToolBench 为 35.8%。因此高 precision 伴随显著 false-negative selection bias；研究没有建立完整 source distribution 上的 recall，也没有验证 hindsight goal 在 live environment 中成立。

其他证据同样受设置约束。论文报告 Qwen2.5 从 1.5B 到 72B 均有提升；Qwen2.5-7B 在 WA-HELDOUT 上迭代部署的 round 0–3 从 17.8 上升到 26.5、27.9、28.2，而 acceptance 从 71.5% 降到 68.4% 与 66.0%。一个包含 363 条 trajectory 的 looping subset 只有 24.2% recoverability、21.5% acceptance 和 3.4 点增益，而 non-looping failure 增益为 9.5 点。这些负面结果与 scaling 结果有助于界定 recipe 的适用范围；任何一项都不能把 benchmark performance 变成 data quality 证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is success-only agent demonstration collection: an episode that fails its original WebArena or ToolBench goal is discarded even if its actions achieved a coherent subgoal. Hindsight experience replay provides the broader idea of relabeling achieved goals, while LLM-as-judge pipelines provide learned selection. AgentHER combines those ideas for natural-language tool-agent episodes and turns the result into explicit supervised and preference records.

What changes is the unit of reuse. The method does not repair or rerun a failure; it preserves the original thought-action-observation sequence, extracts what was actually accomplished, writes a new goal, and filters the pair using two confidence-bearing judges plus a severity weight. It then exposes three downstream views: severity-weighted SFT, cross-goal DPO, and ShareGPT. Failed behavior becomes a positive demonstration only for a goal supported by the recorded observations.

The concrete direction signal is that data construction can treat failure retention and relabeling policy as first-class agent-training infrastructure. The paper's cross-model judge ablation, confidence-filter ablation, human precision audit, false-negative audit, looping-failure slice, and iterative redeployment results make the selection contract inspectable. They are quality signals about the reported procedure, not proof that every generated pair is correct or that an unreleased dataset is reusable.

What is not new includes WebArena, ToolBench, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 rollouts, SFT, DPO, ShareGPT formatting, LoRA, or the general principle of hindsight goal relabeling. The paper does not contribute a new environment, executable relabeled-goal verifier, step-level supervision, replay system, RLVR objective, public experiment corpus, or dataset license.

Before reuse, the paper recipe and released implementation must be treated as separate artifacts. A faithful implementation needs distinct gpt-4o-mini and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct clients, a second-judge acceptance check that includes is_valid, severity semantics aligned with the paper, and untruncated observations where full episodes are claimed. It also needs the raw and accepted/rejected data, immutable split and replay manifests, exact model/tool versions, training/evaluation scripts, and rights documentation.

既有基线是只收集成功 agent demonstration：只要一条 episode 没有完成原始 WebArena 或 ToolBench goal，就会被丢弃，即使其中 action 已经实现了一个连贯 subgoal。Hindsight experience replay 提供了按已实现目标重标的更一般思想，LLM-as-judge pipeline 则提供 learned selection。AgentHER 把两者结合到自然语言 tool-agent episode，并把结果转换为显式监督与偏好记录。

变化发生在复用单元上。该方法不修复或重跑 failure，而是保留原始 thought-action-observation 序列，提取实际完成内容，写出新 goal，并用两个带 confidence 的 judge 与 severity weight 筛选 pair。随后提供三种下游视图：severity-weighted SFT、cross-goal DPO 与 ShareGPT。失败行为只有在目标得到已记录 observation 支持时，才成为该目标的正向示范。

具体方向信号是：数据构造可以把 failure retention 与 relabeling policy 当成 agent-training 基础设施的一等组成。论文的 cross-model judge ablation、confidence-filter ablation、human precision audit、false-negative audit、looping-failure slice 与 iterative redeployment 使 selection contract 可检查。它们是论文所述 procedure 的质量信号，不证明每个生成 pair 都正确，也不证明未发布 dataset 可复用。

非新内容包括 WebArena、ToolBench、gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 rollout、SFT、DPO、ShareGPT 格式、LoRA，以及 hindsight goal relabeling 的一般原则。论文没有提出新 environment、可执行的 relabeled-goal verifier、step-level supervision、replay system、RLVR objective、公开实验语料或 dataset license。

复用前必须把论文 recipe 与公开 implementation 视为两个独立 artifact。忠实实现需要分开的 gpt-4o-mini 与 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct client，需要 second-judge acceptance 同时检查 is_valid，需要让 severity semantics 与论文一致，并在声称 full episode 时保留未截断 observation。还需要 raw 与 accepted/rejected data、不可变 split/replay manifest、精确 model/tool version、training/evaluation script 与 rights documentation。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper evaluates only WebArena and ToolBench. It explicitly leaves cross-environment contamination unresolved, does not provide a human-written hindsight-goal upper bound, and relies on two strong learned judges whose residual bias may affect rare task types. Its noisy-judge theory assumes independent, identically distributed errors and bounded marginal harm; the authors present it as a plausibility argument, not a deployment guarantee.

Selection has both false-positive and false-negative risk. Human majority vote finds 2.9% invalid MJ-X labels on WebArena and 4.0% on ToolBench, while 38.7% and 35.8% of confidence-filtered rejections are human-valid. The reported precision therefore does not describe recall or the original failure distribution. Algorithm 1's 0.4 single-judge fallback further weakens a simple claim that both judges must agree at 0.5.

The inspected code cannot reproduce the paper's cross-model judge contract as configured. AgentHERPipeline constructs one LLMClient and injects it into the detector, extractor, and relabeler; _second_judge calls that same client. It does not instantiate separate gpt-4o-mini and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct services. More seriously, the second-judge acceptance path tests verdict.confidence >= min_confidence but does not check verdict.is_valid, so a high-confidence negative verdict can pass.

Severity semantics point in opposite directions. The paper assigns major errors weights below 0.3 and drops them. The released FailureAnalysis.severity documents 0=mild and 1=catastrophic, rule-based detection raises severity for error keywords, and the pipeline discards values below 0.3 before propagating the same value as the training weight. Without reconciliation, code filtering and weighting do not implement the paper's stated meaning.

The training views also lose trajectory content. SFT and DPO serialization truncate every observation to 300 characters, while ShareGPT keeps full observation text. DPO changes the prompt between chosen and rejected records, which some downstream trainers may not support. None of these formats includes environment version, state snapshot, reset seed, terminal-predicate implementation, tool/API version, timestamp, or replay result, so they are offline text records rather than replayable episodes.

Release completeness is the largest blocker. At inspected commit 98072c34db5ee65a22e43f8621b5ec76a9c995e1, there is no dataset release, Hugging Face page, tag, GitHub Release, experimental WebArena/ToolBench corpus, accepted/rejected relabeling set, WA split JSON, training script, evaluation script, environment adapter, replay manifest, or full annotation UI/guidelines/sample IDs. The repository PDF predates and differs from arXiv v4. Paper CC0-1.0 and code Apache-2.0 do not establish rights for trajectories, benchmark content, generated goals, thoughts, or observations. These gaps block direct training reuse and independent score reproduction.

论文只评测 WebArena 与 ToolBench。它明确没有解决 cross-environment contamination，没有提供 human-written hindsight-goal upper bound，并依赖两个强 learned judge；残余 judge bias 可能影响罕见 task type。其 noisy-judge 理论假设 error 独立同分布且 marginal harm 有界；作者把它定位为 plausibility argument，而不是 deployment guarantee。

selection 同时存在 false-positive 与 false-negative 风险。人类多数票认为 WebArena 的 MJ-X label 有 2.9% 无效，ToolBench 为 4.0%；在 confidence filter 拒绝的 pair 中，人类认为有效的比例分别为 38.7% 与 35.8%。因此报告的 precision 不能描述 recall 或原始 failure distribution。Algorithm 1 的 0.4 single-judge fallback 还会削弱“两个 judge 都必须在 0.5 一致通过”的简单表述。

已检查代码按当前配置无法复现论文 cross-model judge contract。AgentHERPipeline 构造一个 LLMClient，把它同时注入 detector、extractor 与 relabeler；_second_judge 仍调用同一 client。代码没有分别实例化 gpt-4o-mini 与 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct service。更严重的是，second-judge acceptance 只检查 verdict.confidence >= min_confidence，没有检查 verdict.is_valid，因此高 confidence 的否定 verdict 也可能通过。

severity semantics 的方向相反。论文把重大 error 的 weight 设为低于 0.3 并将其丢弃；公开 FailureAnalysis.severity 则说明 0=mild、1=catastrophic，rule-based detection 遇到 error keyword 会提高 severity，pipeline 丢弃低于 0.3 的值后，又直接把同一值作为 training weight。若不先对齐语义，代码 filtering 与 weighting 就没有实现论文所述含义。

training view 还会丢失 trajectory 内容。SFT 与 DPO 序列化把每条 observation 截断为 300 个字符，而 ShareGPT 保留完整 observation text。DPO 的 chosen 与 rejected 记录使用不同 prompt，一些下游 trainer 未必支持。所有格式都缺少 environment version、state snapshot、reset seed、terminal-predicate implementation、tool/API version、timestamp 与 replay result，因此它们是 offline text record，而不是 replayable episode。

发布完整性是最大的 blocker。在已检查 commit 98072c34db5ee65a22e43f8621b5ec76a9c995e1 上，没有 dataset release、Hugging Face 页面、tag、GitHub Release、实验 WebArena/ToolBench 语料、accepted/rejected relabeling set、WA split JSON、training script、evaluation script、environment adapter、replay manifest，或完整 annotation UI/guideline/sample ID。repository PDF 早于且不同于 arXiv v4。论文 CC0-1.0 与代码 Apache-2.0 不能证明 trajectory、benchmark content、generated goal、thought 或 observation 的权利。这些缺口阻止直接训练复用与独立分数复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, AgentHER is a concrete recipe for preserving failed episodes as structured data instead of deleting them. A builder can borrow the separation among original environment outcome, failure type and recoverability, observation-grounded achievement, hindsight goal, judge confidence, severity weight, and downstream serialization. That separation makes it possible to audit which component turns a failure into a training target.

The evidence supports three intended uses only: SFT on hindsight-goal demonstrations, preference learning/DPO over hindsight-versus-original goal records, and agent fine-tuning from the resulting episode text. It does not support RLVR, reward-model training, process supervision, or a claim that the public repository already provides a ready-to-train corpus. The scalar severity value weights supervised or preference losses; it is not an executable verifier reward.

For dataset construction research, the most useful experiment is to vary judge independence, confidence thresholds, fallback policy, severity semantics, and failure classes while reporting both accepted precision and rejected-set false negatives. Looping failures should remain a distinct slice because the paper finds lower recoverability, lower acceptance, and smaller gains. Any derivative DPO pipeline must explicitly support different prompts on the chosen and rejected sides.

For release engineering, this Card turns the track's replay requirement into a checklist: publish record-level raw, accepted, and rejected trajectories; preserve full observations; pin the task split and every environment, model, tool, prompt, tokenizer, and trainer revision; expose executable reset and terminal predicates; release train/eval scripts and replay manifests; state dataset-specific rights; and bind the paper version to an immutable code/data release.

The current reuse class is method/reference only until those artifacts exist and the implementation mismatches are fixed. The repository can help a team understand the package schema and offline relabeling logic, but it cannot reproduce the reported cross-model experiment or supply the reported training records. Evaluation scores should guide hypotheses about the recipe, not certify data quality.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，AgentHER 是一套把失败 episode 保留为结构化数据、而不是直接删除的具体 recipe。构建者可以借鉴它对 original environment outcome、failure type/recoverability、observation-grounded achievement、hindsight goal、judge confidence、severity weight 与下游 serialization 的拆分。这种拆分让审计者可以定位：究竟哪个组件把 failure 转换成 training target。

证据只支持三类预期用途：对 hindsight-goal demonstration 做 SFT；对 hindsight-versus-original goal 记录做 preference learning/DPO；用生成的 episode text 做 agent fine-tuning。证据不支持 RLVR、reward-model training、process supervision，也不支持“公开仓库已提供 ready-to-train corpus”的说法。scalar severity 只用于缩放 supervised/preference loss，不是可执行 verifier reward。

对 dataset construction 研究，最有用的实验是改变 judge independence、confidence threshold、fallback policy、severity semantics 与 failure class，同时报告 accepted precision 和 rejected-set false negative。looping failure 应保留为独立 slice，因为论文发现它们的 recoverability、acceptance 与增益都更低。任何衍生 DPO pipeline 都必须明确支持 chosen 与 rejected 两侧 prompt 不同。

对 release engineering，本卡把该轨道的 replay 要求转换为清单：发布逐记录 raw、accepted 与 rejected trajectory；保留完整 observation；固定 task split 以及每个 environment、model、tool、prompt、tokenizer 与 trainer revision；公开可执行 reset/terminal predicate；发布 train/eval script 与 replay manifest；声明 dataset-specific rights；并把论文版本绑定到不可变 code/data release。

在这些 artifact 出现且 implementation mismatch 修复之前，当前复用等级只能是 method/reference。仓库可以帮助团队理解 package schema 与 offline relabeling logic，却不能复现报告的 cross-model experiment，也不能提供论文所述 training record。evaluation score 只能用于形成关于 recipe 的假设，不能认证 data quality。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1–3.6 and Algorithm 1 together: the object is a fixed failed episode relabeled with an observation-supported goal, and the 0.4 best-candidate fallback is part of the acceptance boundary.
  • Keep the experimental corpus exact: WebArena uses 3,000 failures plus 500 successes from 612 WA-TRAIN tasks, while ToolBench uses 5,000 failures plus 2,000 successes; none of these record-level corpora is publicly released.
  • Separate the signals: benchmark environments determine original success, LLM judges validate the hindsight pair, and severity weights SFT loss or the DPO margin; none is step supervision or RLVR.
  • Audit precision and selection together: MJ-X human precision is 97.1%/96.0% on WebArena/ToolBench, but 38.7%/35.8% of filter-rejected pairs are human-valid.
  • Before reuse, fix the single-LLMClient judge path, require is_valid, align severity direction, remove 300-character SFT/DPO observation truncation, and obtain data, split, scripts, rights, and replay manifests.

• 应把第 3.1–3.6 节与 Algorithm 1 对照阅读：数据对象是用 observation-supported goal 重标的固定失败 episode，0.4 最佳候选 fallback 也是 acceptance boundary 的一部分。
  • 实验语料规模必须写准：WebArena 从 612 个 WA-TRAIN task 收集 3,000 条失败加 500 条成功轨迹，ToolBench 为 5,000 条失败加 2,000 条成功轨迹；这些逐记录 corpus 均未公开。
  • 必须拆分三类信号：benchmark environment 判定原任务 success，LLM judge 验证 hindsight pair，severity 缩放 SFT loss 或 DPO margin；它们都不是 step supervision 或 RLVR。
  • 审计 precision 时必须同时审计 selection：MJ-X 在 WebArena/ToolBench 的 human precision 为 97.1%/96.0%，但 filter 拒绝的 pair 中有 38.7%/35.8% 被人类判定有效。
  • 复用前应修复单一 LLMClient judge 路径、强制检查 is_valid、对齐 severity 方向、移除 SFT/DPO 的 300 字符 observation 截断，并补齐 data、split、script、rights 与 replay manifest。

value.html: WebArena WA-TRAIN (612 collection-only tasks from a 612/200 task-disjoint split) and the official ToolBench training splits. The paper reports 500 successful and 3,000 failed WebArena trajectories and 2,000 successful and 5,000 failed ToolBench trajectories, but no record-level corpus or split manifest was found in the public repository.

An accepted failed episode is paired with a new hindsight prompt and serialized as either an SFT conversation, a DPO chosen/rejected record, or a ShareGPT multi-turn conversation. The trajectory itself is not regenerated by the paper method.

gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 collects the failed and successful environment trajectories in the reported experiments. gpt-4o-mini extracts outcomes and proposes hindsight goals; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct is the paper's independent second judge.

Offline WebArena web-navigation and ToolBench API/tool-use episodes. The released package consumes JSON/JSONL trajectory text; it does not include environment adapters, reset logic, executable terminal predicates, or replay manifests.

Initial failure and terminal success originate from the benchmark environments. For a hindsight pair, the paper requires a gpt-4o-mini relabeler and an independently trained Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct verifier to each assign confidence at least theta=0.5; a failure-severity weight scales SFT loss or the DPO margin. This learned contract checks support in recorded observations, not live replay of the environment.

Original-task success is benchmark-specific. Relabeled-pair acceptance is judge-based: both paper judges must clear theta=0.5, with up to three attempts, although Algorithm 1 also permits a best single-judge fallback at 0.8*theta. A version-pinned executable predicate for each episode is not released.
Reported fine-tuned/evaluated models are GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72B/7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5 checkpoints from 1.5B to 72B for the scaling study.
gpt-4o-mini is the LLM failure detector when enabled, outcome extractor, and hindsight prompt relabeler; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct is the paper's cross-model verifier.

gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 generates environment trajectories; the four-stage offline pipeline performs failure classification, factual outcome extraction, hindsight-prompt synthesis and verification, then deterministic SFT/DPO/ShareGPT packaging.

WebArena uses 3,000 failed and 500 successful WA-TRAIN trajectories; ToolBench uses 5,000 failed and 2,000 successful trajectories from official training splits. Reported MJ-X acceptance is 71.5% and 75.5%, respectively.
3,000 WebArena failures plus 500 successes; 5,000 ToolBench failures plus 2,000 successes. Per-task rollout budgets and the complete raw rollout corpus are unknown.
gpt-4o-mini relabeler T=0.3 on the first attempt and T=0.7 on retries; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct verifier T=0. Failure detector and outcome extractor are reported at T=0 in Appendix A.

Reject irrecoverable or major-flaw runs with severity weight below delta=0.3. Retry relabeling at most three times and accept when both paper judges reach theta=0.5; Algorithm 1 retains a best single-judge fallback at confidence at least 0.4.
At most three relabeling attempts; Table 2 reports 4.27 LLM calls per input trajectory for MJ-X. Environment step/token limits are unknown. Open-weight training uses maximum sequence length 4,096.

Open-weight models use LoRA SFT for 3 epochs and LoRA DPO for 1 epoch in ms-swift on 8 A100-80G GPUs; the paper reports rank 16, alpha 32, and DPO beta 0.1. GPT-4o uses the OpenAI fine-tuning API; an 8-shot ICL variant is also evaluated without fine-tuning.

Failed and successful trajectories from WebArena and ToolBench, collected by gpt-3.5-turbo-0125. Record-level task IDs, selection yields before the reported totals, and raw accepted/rejected relabelings are not publicly released.

WebArena is split into 612 WA-TRAIN tasks and 200 WA-HELDOUT evaluation tasks, stratified by category with seed 0. ToolBench uses official training and G1/G2/G3 test splits. The paper says the WebArena split JSON is released, but it is absent from the inspected repository snapshot.

Training uses WebArena and ToolBench training tasks and evaluates on WA-HELDOUT and ToolBench official test splits. Appendix D.1 reports that the standard full WebArena evaluation has modest task-overlap leakage; cross-environment contamination remains unknown.

The task-disjoint WebArena split and environment reset reduce within-WebArena overlap. The paper explicitly says cross-environment contamination is not removed; no broader text-, task-, or model-pretraining decontamination procedure is disclosed.

The experiments retain successful demonstrations and accepted relabeled failures for training. Major/irrecoverable failures and confidence-filtered relabelings are rejected; the public repository contains examples only, not the complete retained/rejected sets.

The method reuses serialized trajectories without extra environment interaction, but the release has no environment version, state snapshot, task manifest, reset seed, tool/API version, terminal-predicate implementation, or deterministic replay log.

items: Learned judges can approve hindsight prompts that are observation-supported yet still biased toward frequent task types; the paper reports 2.9% invalid MJ-X labels on WebArena and 4.0% on ToolBench under human majority vote.
The confidence filter rejects pairs of which 38.7% on WebArena and 35.8% on ToolBench are judged valid by humans, creating substantial false-negative selection bias.
The paper's theoretical bound assumes perfect judges or i.i.d. bounded judge errors and is explicitly a plausibility argument, not a deployment guarantee.
The released PipelineConfig injects one LLMClient into all stages, so it cannot reproduce the paper's gpt-4o-mini plus Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct cross-model contract without code changes.
The released second-judge acceptance path compares only confidence and does not check SecondJudgeVerdict.is_valid; a high-confidence rejection can therefore pass in the inspected implementation.

FailureAnalysis.severity is documented in code as 0=mild and 1=catastrophic, whereas the paper's severity weight gives major errors values below 0.3. The pipeline thresholds and propagates the code severity directly, so release semantics do not match the paper recipe.

SFT and DPO serialization truncate every observation to 300 characters; the released records are not full replayable trajectories. DPO also changes the prompt between chosen and rejected conversations, which downstream trainers must handle explicitly.

The repository lacks the reported experiment datasets, WA split JSON, annotation interface/guidelines/sample IDs, environment adapters, and fine-tuning/evaluation scripts; reported scores cannot be reproduced from the public package alone.
